records.title: Long-tailed Recognition with Model Rebalancing
records.reason: Model Rebalancing adjusts parameter allocation for long-tailed visual recognition and evaluates classification performance. It does not concern language-model generation or inference resource use; the DeepSpeed Inference citation is not reflected in the paper's objective or evaluated system.

records.title: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of State Space Models
records.reason: Full experiments compare LoRA placement across Mamba/Jamba-like SSMs and tasks; the contribution is adaptation/training parameters, not serving inference efficiency.

records.title: Efficient Alternating Minimization with Applications to Weighted Low Rank Approximation
records.reason: Full text proves and evaluates a faster general low-rank optimization algorithm, but does not apply it to LLM weight compression or inference; its model-compression citation link merits a weak lead only.

records.title: A Survey on LLM Mid-training
records.reason: The survey covers LLM mid-training data, architecture, and training strategies for capability acquisition. It synthesizes training-stage work rather than presenting a serving/inference optimization, and the YaRN citation alone does not make mid-training a context-extension method.

records.title: Efficient and robust temporal processing with neural oscillations modulated spiking neural networks
records.reason: Full text evaluates spiking models on temporal, speech, and Penn Tree Bank language-modeling tasks and reports energy reductions, but it is not an LLM inference method; retain only as a weak recurrent-sequence lineage connection.
